name: threads
description: Starts background Claude Code helpers, each in its own Herdr git worktree, and tells you when one finishes or needs you.

maxThreads.title: Live helpers allowed
maxThreads.description: How many helpers may be live at once. A helper that finished but was not closed still counts.

defaultModel.title: Default Claude model
defaultModel.description: Model of a Claude helper when the call gives none: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus, fable) or a full name. Empty means the model of the chat that starts it.

defaultPermissionMode.title: Default permission mode
defaultPermissionMode.description: Permission mode of Claude helpers. acceptEdits lets them edit and commit; anything else stops them as blocked until you answer.

pollSeconds.title: Status check interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often live helpers are checked.
